title: Console & Tooling Standup - 2026-08-18
body:
Date: 2026-08-18
Attendees: Lucas Martin (owner), Priya Kapoor, Jamal Ortiz, Evelyn Park, Nina Alvarez, Samir Bose (observability)

Quick highlights
- Canary for new Rollouts page frontend (UI v2) is live for 2% of orgs. Initial telemetry looks okay but we saw slight increase in render latency on mobile.
- Analytics pipeline refactor (route-level telemetry) merged to staging; long-running job fixed, running nightly backfills this week.
- Small regression in rollout history filter: some entries with missing user metadata showing as "Unknown" - root cause is a nullable event field in the rollout-service (ticket JIRA-PLAT-1987).

Updates by area
1) UI - Rollouts page (Priya)
- Progress: Canary launched 2026-08-14 at 00:00 UTC to 2% of orgs via feature flag. Frontend telemetry: +8% bundle parse time on low-end Android due to extra client-side filtering.
- Next: Add incremental index for history filter (client + server) to avoid O(n^2) rendering; target patch deploy by 2026-08-20.
- Blockers: Need a small backend endpoint change (team eng-platform) to return user display names for archived audits. Blocker tracked in JIRA-UI-2052.

2) Analytics & Observability (Samir / Jamal)
- Progress: New route-level metrics exported to Datadog; dashboards published for per-route token cost and p95 latency.
- Current metric callouts: console-route p95 = 210ms (global avg), serving fallback path spikes in EU region during peak (p95 ~ 380ms) - suspected routing to older dedicated pools.
- Action: Jamal to follow up with infra routing team to verify policy rules. Also increasing sampling for traces on canary traffic for 48 hours.

3) Backend & Rollouts Service (Lucas / Nina)
- Progress: Fix for nullable user metadata merged to staging; migration script to backfill missing names scheduled for 2026-08-19.
- Risk: Backfill touches audit table; Nina to coordinate with security for audit retention and ensure no PII leak in logs.

4) Integrations & SDK (Evelyn)
- Progress: Streaming SDK minor release (v0.9.3) includes improved reconnect logic for console previews. Release candidate tested in staging.
- Next: Release to prod after smoke tests on 2026-08-19. Noted a small change in SSE headers that broke one internal demo; patch PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/418.

Blockers / Risks
- Rollout history filter bug (JIRA-PLAT-1987) - blocks full enablement of the new Rollouts UI until backfills and API change are confirmed.
- EU routing spike - high priority to avoid Canary traffic being misrouted to old pools. Potential customer impact if sustained.
- Mobile render perf on low-end Android could degrade user experience for some customers; need to triage and possibly ship a smaller client bundle for canary group.

Decisions / Notes
- Keep canary at 2% until backfill + EU routing checks complete. If no regressions by 2026-08-22, increase to 10%.
- For mobile perf, ship a client-only optimization toggle for canary orgs rather than rolling back component changes.

Action Items (owners and due dates)
- Priya: Implement server-side index + minimal client rendering changes, PR by 2026-08-19.
- Nina: Run backfill migration and validate audit entries with security, run date 2026-08-19.
- Jamal: Investigate EU routing spikes, coordinate with infra, update status by 2026-08-18 EOD.
- Evelyn: Complete streaming SDK smoke tests and schedule prod release for 2026-08-19.
- Samir: Increase trace sampling on canary traffic for 48h starting 2026-08-18, share trace links for any 5xxs.

Notes / Misc
- Linked to larger rollout canary plan in Confluence (see linked_artifacts).
- We should add a small postmortem template for any canary that produces p95 > 2x baseline; will draft in next retro.

Meeting adjourned. Next standup: 2026-08-25.

Raw refs / links included above: JIRA-PLAT-1987, JIRA-UI-2052, PR #418, Confluence canary plan.
